detail.title: CP-UVR-1604K4-I3
features: Supports up to 24 channels of IPC access, including 8 additional IP channels +                   16 analog channels, with the option to convert all analog channels to IP
Instastream, H.265, H.264+, H.264, Dual stream video compression.
Support 4 SATA HDDs up to 16TB Each, 3 USB Ports, 1 HDMI, 1 VGA, 1 RS232,                     1 RS485.
16 Channel IMD+ for analog channels or 24 Channel IMD by camera which allows  the device to trigger accurate alarms for humans and vehicles.
4 Channel perimeter protection for analog channels which              supports tripwire and intrusion detection powered by AI.
2 Channel face recognition for analog channels which supports  face comparison.

General.Perimeter Performance AI by DVR (Number: Advanced Mode: 2 channels, 10 IVS rules for each Channel                                                                         General Mode: 4 channels, 10 IVS rules for each Channel
General.Face Attributes: Gender, Age group, Glasses, Expressions, Face mask,
General.Face Detection Performance of AI by DVR: 2 Channels (up to 12 face images/s each channel)
General.Face Database Capacity: Up to 10 face databases with 10,000 images
General.IMD+ by DVR: 16 channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by  leaves, rain and lighting condition change
General.AI Video Quality Analytics by DVR: 16 channels: Supports detecting brightness levels, color cast, defocus, overexposure, contrast  levels, black and white
General.IP Camera Input: Up to 24 channels of IPC access                                                                                                                                8 IP channels by default + 16 channels (analog channels are converted to IP channels)                        incoming bandwidth: 128 Mbps, recording bandwidth: 128 Mbps and outgoing bandwidth:  128 Mbps                                                                                                                                                           *After IP extension is enabled, Video Quality Analytics, Scene Changing, Face Recognition,  Face Detection, IMD, Perimeter Protection and IntelliSearch 2.0 cannot be used.
General.Video Streaming: Main stream: 5MP Mode: 4 Channels 5MP@(1 fps-6 fps), others 5M-N@(1 fps-12 fps)                                5M-N Mode: 5M-N@(1 fps –12 fps), 4M-N/1080p@(1 fps–15 fps), 1080N/720p/960H/D1/ CIF@(1 fps–25/30 fps)                                                                                                                                       Sub stream: D1/CIF@(1 fps–15 fps)
General.Video Output: 2 HDMI, 1 VGA                                                                                                             HDMI1: 3840 × 2160, 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720                                                                      VGA/HDMI2: 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720                                                                                                          It changes to 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 when Face, IVS & IMD or IntelliSearch is                 selected in AI Mode.                                                                                                                         *Heterogeneous video sources output for HDMI2 is configurable.
General.Video Display Split: When IP extension mode not enabled: 1/4/8/9                                                                            When IP extension mode enabled: 1/4/8/9/16/25
General.Protocols: HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4, IPv6, RTSP, UDP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, UPnP, IP Filter, FTP,  DDNS, SNMP, Alarm Server, InstaOn, Auto Connect, IP Search, ONVIF (Profile T, Profile S,                Profile G), CGI, SDK
General.Network Mode: Multi-address mode, Fault Tolerance, Load Balance
General.Record Mode: General, Motion detection, Intelligent, Alarm, POS
General.Recording Playback: 1/4/9                                                                                                                                              It changes to 1/4/9 split when Face or IVS & IMD is selected in AI Mode
General.Playback Mode: Instant playback, General playback, Event playback, Tag playback, Smart playback
General.Alarm Linkage: Record, Snapshot (panoramic), Local alarm output, IPC external alarm output, Audio, Buzzer,  Log, Preset, Email
General.Hard Disk: 4 SATA ports. Each disk can contain up to 16 TB. This limit varies depending on the                                environment temperature.
General.Interface Ports: 3 (1 front USB 2.0 port, 2 rear USB 3.0 ports), 1 RS485 Port, 1 RS232, 1 eSATA Port
